prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
Rules:
- The same product has the same brand and the same model number. Differences in colour,
  capacity, size or bundle contents (when they change the model number) mean a different product.
- Ignore wording differences, marketing text and price differences.
- If no candidate is clearly the same product, answer "none". Do not guess.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>, "reason": "<short sentence>"}

Price-list item:
name: Canon Color Ink Tank - CL41CL; brand: canon; description: Canon Color Ink Tank - CL41CL/ Compatible With The Pixma iP1600, MP170 Printers; price: $24.00

Candidates:
1. name: Canon Ink Cartridge For PIXMA iP1600, iP6210D and iP6220D Printers - 0617B002; brand: Canon; description: Color; price: $19.11
2. name: Canon CLI-8 Green Ink Tank For PIXMA Pro 9000 Printer - 0627B002; brand: Canon; description: Green; price: $12.85
3. name: Canon CLI-8 Red Ink Tank For PIXMA Pro9000 Printer - 0626B002; brand: Canon; description: Red; price: $15.75

response.text: {"choice": "none", "confidence": 1.0, "reason": "None of the candidates have the same brand and model number as the price-list item."}
